src: That's a shame.
I can try.
Thank you. I wish you the best of luck with that.
You'll find Morrowmeat in the Meat Quarry of the market area. He's the... eh, central attraction.
Get us some help for making a stand against the machines.
We think that Mother, the Titan under the city, could support us, and the way to her leads through Morrowmeat in the Meat Quarry.
Grant us full control of the Administration.
I'm not sure how, but I guess you can command one of the terminals over there to do it.
I have this weapon against the Administration.
Show it to me.
That's... Yes. This could work.
We would use that to cripple the mainframe, make the whole complex vulnerable, and then get in and destroy the rest of them by force.
Give this software module to me, and I will prepare the attack.
But I think it would also be fair if you took a moment to consider your options.
I'll think about it.
OK. Fair enough.
Let's do this.
I applaud your wisdom. This is the only path forward.
Let's meet again at the Administration.
FRIENDS! Gather around.
For too long now we have been living under the thumb of the machines.
They have suppressed us. They have curbed our lives, have dictated us what to do and what not to do.
This ends today!
Here, with our new friend, we have the means finally to throw off this iron yoke.
We will send an electronic shock through the security bots, which will hopefully cripple most of them, and then we'll fight against what remains of them.
Let's prepare this attack. Let's take back our freedom!
Finally some action!
Let them have it!
I handed over control of the Administration to you.
This is fabulous.
Thank you. You did good, my friend.
I defeated the Administration.
You did... you did what?
I found a weapon against the Administration. And then I went over there and used it.
You did this on your own?
Well...
That is astonishing.
If this means that you have access to the inner core of the Administration now, then grant us full control of it.
Us humans, I mean.
I'll have to think about it.
Please, I implore you, make the right decision here.
We're on the same team.
I guess I could to that.
Ahh, this will be good.
Finally some light among all this darkness and uncertainty.
I already did.
The Collectors took over the Administration.
I noticed. What a disappointing turn of events.
Years of violence and oppression by the machines. Now to be continued by the other faction.
It's... it's gonna be hard.
We will survive this, Gavas. We have endured the treacherous machines and we will endure the Collectors.
I know, I know. You're right. I should not give in to despair now.
Welcome, my friend.
Did Protas send you? That was very thoughtful of him.
We need any help we can get. I mean, help from someone who's an ally, of course.
Recently, we discovered an agent of the Machines and had to dismantle it.
So, are you one of us? Then participate.
Let's meet at the Administration.
Hey. Shall we begin?
Let's wait a bit.
Alright.
Let's begin.
Alright.
Let's go, people.
Follow me.
Down with the machines!
Follow me.
Hey. Shall I upload the virus?
There's probably gonna be some fighting ahead.
Alright.
Yes. Let's do this.
Oh. Wait a minute... Where's the software module?
I'm uploading the software now.
It's gonna be your task to get through to the end of the second floor and disable the main computer.
Good luck.
We did it. We did it!
Thanks so much for fighting on our side.
Now we'll begin the peaceful reign of the city.
The Admins, they are watching us. We have to be careful when we install the new protocol.
I've mentioned to Gavas that we should try to reach Mother. She's real. She has to be. All her connections...
I believe she's the master of the data matrix here in the city. She can give us power over the Admins. Maybe also over the Villa. That would be grand.
So far so good. Protocol installed and keeping strict control of all access points.
We have to make sure that there are no holes in our firewall. Because the Machine God will not rest.
So you got thrown into the Crystal City like the rest of us, I assume?
The city calls out to us. However, it's hard to tell exactly what it's saying.
What I know is this: there's some treacherous machine behind every corner. That's what experience tells me.
Turn to Gavas if you want to help us get out of this mess.
Hey, stranger. Nice to meet you.
So you got thrown into the Crystal City to be our savior, I guess.
I commend you.
But don't sleep too soundly.
The treacherous machines might still get their revenge.
It's a shame that Gavas had to give his life in order for us to succeed, but I know that he would be proud of what we accomplished so far.
Tell me something.
This one is fresh: There was a Titan let loose in the city. Not like the other ones, the stuffy sitting-around type, but one with legs.
This Titan crashed a party at the Collectors. Big mistake! So they put him into one of their torture thingies.
You know what they say about Lenadra?
That she's grooming young men like Gavas for... you know what I mean.
There's a sexual monster living far to the south from here. A baroness, or a duchess. You know, one of those aristocratic titles from ancient times.
People say that she lost her lover, and that made her go crazy.
There's a giant eyeball in the north that's revered like a God.
Someone kicked it though, right where it hurts, and that didn't do a lot for people's confidence in the divine eyeball.
This one's so true it's almost a fact: The Collectors ruled this land once before the machines came.
The Collectors were like queens and kings. And now they want their stuff back. All of it.
Wow. We overthrew them.
Can't believe I'm still alive.
I see a lot of things. I come around.
The others here? They're smart, sure. But they don't get the full picture like I do.
If you want to partake in my knowledge, let me know.
About Ira...
I can't believe that she followed through with her project by using her own body. She shouldn't have.
Now she's hurting. And I can't do anything about that.
It should have been me instead of her.
So what's your role here?
A bit of this, a bit of that.
Making sure no one bothers my wife too much.
I'm old, but I am still strong enough to protect her.
What's up with Ira's research?
Well, the research is about life in general. And motivation. And how the flesh is driven by... by something, I guess.
I can see the appeal. To be interested in that. I just wish Ira wouldn't be so zealous about it.
It's too much sometimes. You know what I mean?
Hey. Nice to meet you.
Are you here to talk about Ira's research?
I can't be of much help there. Don't understand many of the details myself.
I don't like how feverish she...
Ah, sorry. That's none of your concern.
Ira...
[He sobs.]
I don't feel so good.
Hey.
What's new?
Not much, really.
Have you been to the Villa? And did you talk to Protas at the market?
If not, you should.
Hey, you're new here, right?
Did you get out of that old metro building?
Maybe?
Any food in there that's not meat?
No.
Damn it. I can't stand the meat anymore.
Any rogue machines in there?
Rogue machines?
You know. The ones that attack anyone on sight. They're everywhere.
No. There weren't any hostile machines in there.
Have you seen any Titan Machine thing enter the city recently?
A what?
A large humanoid machine or maybe a walking Titan. The 'Feeder'.
One of them flesh thingies? There's one here in the city. At the Meat Quarry, near the market.
But that one doesn't walk anymore. So it's probably a different one.
There was some commotion at the Villa of the Collectors. Maybe that's related.
You could go over there and see what's what.
But make sure to also talk to Protas in the market.
Old friend of mine. He knows stuff.
Thanks.
Welcome, visitor. My records show no previous attendance of your person in our beloved city.
Unfortunately, the city is currently under lockdown.
What is this city?
It's the Crystal City. Formerly great, now perished. It is our home, our past and our future.
Who's running this place?
The city is governed by us, the benevolent machines, on behalf of all citizens. It's our mandate.
About the lockdown...
It's temporary, and it means that you cannot enter or leave the city.
I just entered.
Not with our permission. We ask you to not leave this place while the lockdown is in place.
Hey!
This looks interesting.
Right? I am pretty happy with it. Some of them were really hard to get.
I quite like how it's all coming together now.
Some of them look a bit fresh.
None of them are fresh. I made sure that there's not a living one among them. And the last one I added is a few days old already.
So what's the purpose of this?
Aesthetics, mainly. I'm a collector, and the simple purpose and bliss of a collector lies in the beauty of the heap itself.
But...
I have begun a new journey in my life, a new chapter. And creating this mound, gathering the parts, it's essential for this new chapter.
What's this new chapter?
I'm becoming an artist.
I will become the best fucking corpse artist in the Crystal City. Everyone will know me and and speak of the one true artist in the city.
And they will remember me, and through that I will become eternal.
You are not an artist just because you're collecting stuff. Even if that stuff consists of dead people.
That's what the arrangement is for, stupid. Wouldn't be art if there was no composition to it. Creating the heap, now that's where the real art is.
Finding the right place for it. Placing the parts. And maintaining the style and atmosphere of the parts, of course.
This is great art.
I knew it.
I KNEW IT!
What do you like most about it?
Uhm...
